attchmntText: DS Kulkarni Developers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: D S Kulkarni Developers Limited approved its Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. The Board meeting was held in Pune. Standalone net profit for the half year was 1,610.46 lakhs. Consolidated net profit for the half year was 51.13 lakhs. Standalone total income for the quarter was 5,714.73 lakhs. Standalone total assets as at September 30, 2026, were 96,029.36 lakhs. Consolidated total assets were 94,489.75 lakhs. Standalone cash and cash equivalents were 407.01 lakhs. Consolidated cash and cash equivalents were 407.16 lakhs. The Company acquired 100% of Moonbrick Realty Private Limited effective July 13, 2026. The Company acquired 100% of Westpole Spaces Private Limited on October 5, 2026. Bhushan Vilas Palresha, DIN 01258918, signed the results as Managing Director.

attchmntText: DS Kulkarni Developers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Mohammad Aslam as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. October 30, 2026.
DS Kulkarni Developers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 30, 2026.
